$comment: Balanced hybrid preset for a machine with BOTH OpenAI and OpenCode Go providers, refreshed 2026-11-16. OpenAI takes the reasoning and vision lanes: GPT-6.1 Sol for orchestration/review, GPT-6.1 Terra for design and visual analysis (writing, vision, speed at $1/$5). OpenCode Go DeepSeek V4.1-Flash keeps the high-volume cheap lanes (explorer, fixer) with its $100 Go quota. Apply with: ./setup.sh --preset hybrid. Agents not listed follow the global model.
